title: Karna hai chehlum ayiye
body:
1) FATEMA KE LAAL KA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
AAYIYE AHL-E-AZA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
2) QAID SE HOKAR REHA
JATA HAI KUNBA KARBALA
LAB PE YE ZAINAB KE THA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
3) BHAAYI KA CHAHLUM KARUNGI
KAHTI THI ZAINAB YEHI
DIL MEI ARMAAN RAH GAYA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
4) NAAZON SE PAALA THA MAA NE
PEES KAR CHAKKI JISE
TASHNA LAB WO REH GAYA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
5) AALAM-E-TANHAYI MEI
SEHRA KI JALTI RAIT PAR
BE KAFAN LASHA RAHA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
6) ASGHAR-E-MASOOM KA
AUR AKBAR-E-ZEESHAN KA
QASIM-O-ABBAS KA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
7) ZAINAB-E-DILGEER KA
KOI NAHI AB AASRA
DETI HAI ROKAR SADA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
8) ARBAYEEN-E-SHAH KI
HOTI HAI MAQSOOSI WAHAN
JAATE HAIN HUM KARBALA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
9) EK DIN MEI HOGAYA
ZEHRA KE GHAR KA KHAATEMA
FATEMA KE AAL KA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
10) BIBI ZAINAB KI DUA KA
HAI ASAR ABBAS YE
HOTI HAI MAJLIS BAPA
KARNA HAI CHEHLUM AAYIYE
